siniestro.descripcion: Tell us what happened to start evaluating your case.

informacion.descripcionAyuda: Between 10 and 2,000 characters. Tell us what happened, where and how.
informacion.montoAyuda: What you think it cost, in pesos.

evidencia.opcional: This step is optional: you can send the report without evidence.
evidencia.app: In the app you can take photos with the date and location of the event.
evidencia.limites: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 or PDF, up to {{limite}} each.

rechazo.formato: {{nombre}}: this format isn't supported. Use JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 or PDF.

fallo.formato: {{nombre}}: not attached because its content isn't JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 or PDF.
fallo.tamano: {{nombre}}: not attached because it's larger than 10 MB.
fallo.cerrado: {{nombre}}: not attached because the claim is already closed.
fallo.almacenamiento: {{nombre}}: not attached because evidence storage didn't respond. Try again in a few minutes.
fallo.error: {{nombre}}: we couldn't attach it. Try again.

revision.aviso: Once you send it, your report will be registered and its evaluation will begin.

confirmacion.detalle: We received your report. Keep the reference number: it's the same on the web and in the app.

siguientePaso.adjuntar_evidencia: Attach any photos, invoices or documents you have to speed up the evaluation.
siguientePaso.esperar_evaluacion: We're evaluating your case; we'll let you know when its status changes.

errores.fechaFutura: The event date can't be later than today.
errores.fueraDeVigencia: The event must have happened between {{inicio}} and {{fin}}, while the policy was active.
errores.descripcionCorta: Describe what happened in at least 10 characters.
errores.descripcionLarga: The description allows up to 2,000 characters.
errores.montoInvalido: Enter the amount in pesos, using numbers only.
errores.enviar: We couldn't confirm your report was sent. Try again: if it had already arrived, you'll see the same reference number.
errores.polizaNoEncontrada: The selected policy is no longer available. Review the event details.
errores.fueraDeVigenciaServidor: This event isn't covered: it happened outside the policy's coverage (from {{inicio}} to {{fin}}). No report was registered.

evidencias.descripcion: Attach photos, videos or documents to a claim you already reported, on the web or in the app.
